Tess (CS): Quick alert 9h cohort for Beacon preview hit cap at 21. We have 3 accounts flagged for risk if delayed: Novus (renewal + POC), Wren (security review), Atlas (custom mapping).
Ravi (AE): Can we prioritize Novus and Atlas? Those are on the Q2 expansion list.
Tess (CS): Prioritizing Novus + Atlas. I'm proposing a "fast-track" path: recorded + guaranteed 1:1 office hour within 3 business days. That reduces live seats needed.
Lina (PM): Fine by me, but we need survey instrumentation to record "fast-track" vs "standard" and a follow-up tag for NPS<=2. Survey link: https://tiny.redwood/beacon-survey. Also request: include a free-text field for top 1 blocker.
Ben (SE): I can run the 1:1 for Atlas; need access to their sample payloads beforehand. @Tess can you request a S3 link or paste in invite?
Tess (CS): Requested samples from Atlas contact. If no reply in 24h we proceed with generic examples and make the 1:1 discovery-first.
Echo-bot: FYI 1: cohort_size >20 will auto-waitlist. Current size=21.
Ravi (AE): I'll ping Novus to confirm they accept fast-track recorded + office hour. If they want live, we'll move someone who picked recorded.
Tess (CS): Actions: [Ravi] confirm Novus (pending), [Ben] prep Atlas 1:1 (assigned), [Lina] add fast-track flag to survey (pending), [CS Ops] create waitlist hold for anyone untagged.
Ravi (AE): Novus confirmed fast-track. Moved them off live seat.
Tess (CS): Perfect 1ive up 2 live seats then. I'll update cohort count and remove auto-waitlist trigger. Recap tomorrow AM.
